caption: The drawing depicts a horse in a prancing posture, facing left, with four visible legs and a raised tail. The horse has a white or beige body featuring several black patches on its neck, torso, and legs. The hooves and tail are entirely black. There is a rectangular plank or signboard attached to the horse’s body, which extends across its midsection from front to back. On this plank, the words “E. DORA AND SONS TAXI AND TRANSFER” are written in uppercase letters, with “AND” and “AND SONS” written in a smaller size above the main text. The background of the image is plain and uncolored, and the drawing is done in black ink or pencil on a lightly yellowed paper. At the bottom right corner of the image, the name “SYD ROBERTS” is written in uppercase letters.
title: Livery Stable Sign
